test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who chairs the Defence Acquisition Council (DAC)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Defence Minister Rajnath Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Defence Acquisition Council (DAC)** is the highest decision-making body in the Ministry of Defence.
 
• The DAC is responsible for the **overall guidance** of the defence procurement planning process.
 
• The council was formed to ensure **expeditious procurement** of the approved requirements of the armed forces.
 
• It is chaired by the **Defence Minister** of India, who is currently **Rajnath Singh**.
 
• The DAC clears all defence procurement proposals that are above a certain financial threshold.
 
• It was constituted in the year **2001**, following the recommendations of the **Group of Ministers** on national security.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **President Droupadi Murmu**__

 __
 
• The President of India is the **head of state** and the **Supreme Commander of the Armed Forces**.
 
• The President's role is more **ceremonial**, and the actual decision-making power in defence matters lies with the **Defence Minister**.
 
 
 
• **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**__
 __
 
• The Prime Minister of India is the **head of government** and plays a crucial role in **national security** and **defence policy**.
 
• However, the specific responsibility of chairing the **Defence Acquisition Council** lies with the **Defence Minister**.
 
 
 
• **National Security Advisor Ajit Doval**__
 
 
• The National Security Advisor (NSA) is responsible for advising the Prime Minister on **national security** and **strategic interests**.
 
• The NSA does not chair the **Defence Acquisition Council** but plays an important role in shaping **defence and security policies**.
